title: 60-Inch Extended 3-Post Grab Bar (Ada Compliant) | Pipeline Grab Bars | Allied Brass
body_html:
Make the bathroom safer and easier to navigate with an extended-length grab bar that provides steady support for daily routines.

  • More coverage for accessible layouts — extended 60-inch length supports movement along a longer span.
  • Stability you can rely on — 3-post design includes a third center bracket for added support.
  • Coordinate your space — part of the Pipeline grab bars collection for a consistent look across the bath.
  • Designed for versatile bathrooms — complements transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
  • Finish options for your décor — available in multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Details

  • Product type: Extended 3-post bathroom grab bar
  • ADA Compliant
  • Overall dimensions: 63 in. L x 3 in. H x 3.58 in. W (60-inch grab bar)
  • Box dimensions: 64 in. x 6 in. x 8 in.
  • Shipping weight: 6 lbs
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

_previous.title: Pipeline Extended 3 Post Grab Bar - 60 inch
_previous.description: Make your bathroom a safer and more accessible space with the extended length 3 post grab bar from the Allied Brass Pipeline Collection. Designed with the needs of seniors, people with disabilities, and caregivers in mind, this grab bar provides balance, security, and ease of use. The industrial look of the Pipeline collection adds a modern touch to any bathroom decor, while the lifetime materials ensure a clean, decorative finish that lasts for years. With superior materials that are free from corrosion and rust, this grab bar is a reliable and stylish addition to your bathroom. Trust Allied Brass to provide high-quality bathroom fittings that enhance your safety and comfort. Contemporary pipe design with industrial influences ADA Compliant Bars feature a third center bracket to ensure stability Protected using highly durable powder coat finish Designer finish will provide Corrosion-free and rust-free performance Provided with a limited lifetime warranty Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 63x3x3.58 Box dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 64x6x8 Shipping weight, lbs: 6 Installation Instruction Technical Specification P-730-GB360-Installation.pdf P-730-GB360-Specification.pdf
